scope: platform student deletion and legacy platform mutation lifecycle

requiredProof.freshSetup: Apply through the production migration loader on empty provisioned stores, then run every normal application initializer and seed.
requiredProof.populatedUpgrade: Apply to private copies of the configured stores containing representative instructor edits, learner rows, pending judgments, scoped legacy content, and ambiguous historical legacy rows; preserve every non-target byte.
requiredProof.repeat: Run the same production initializers again and require an empty migration replay with exact ledger name/checksum equality.
requiredProof.runtime: Require all 17 durable cleanup steps, strict capability ACL checks, hidden-catalog SecureShop cleanup, one failed-step retry on the same job, session revocation, owner removal, and sibling preservation through the mounted admin route.

qualification: Revised 0040 passed owned PostgreSQL 18 with active admin and super-admin mutation/upload admission, canonical JWT continuity, cross-owner/locked/revoked denial, lifecycle races, exact cleanup, and loader replay.

activation.default: required when PLATFORM_DATABASE_ENGINE=postgres and LEGACY_PLATFORM_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED is unset or true
activation.publishBoundary: Do not listen for HTTP until normal PostgreSQL initialization and retained deletion composition readiness both succeed.
